claims.rationale: The French label cites a risk of adverse interactions with venlafaxine, notably CNS depressant effects, and advises avoiding alcohol; the English rendering is faithful.
The abstract of the randomized crossover study in 16 healthy men reports no pharmacodynamic interaction with ethanol.
The abstract reports no effect of ethanol on venlafaxine or O-desmethylvenlafaxine disposition and none of venlafaxine on ethanol disposition.
